processNotes.reasoningModelEmptyContent: MEASURED at C-058 on the G13 model: with a declared json_schema, max_tokens 1024 produced 1024 completion tokens, 4024 chars of reasoning_content, and EMPTY content. The fix is chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false} or reasoning_effort 'none' (96 tokens, schema-conformant). The prompt-level /no_think switch is IGNORED by this template. Binds 12.1's per-role token budgets and 12.2's setup probe.
processNotes.ctxSizeIsTotalNotPerSlot: MEASURED at C-058: --ctx-size is llama-server's TOTAL context, divided among slots. --parallel 6 with an unchanged --ctx-size 8192 cut per-slot context from 8192 to 1536. Task 12.1's derivation is TWO-valued: --parallel = slots AND --ctx-size = per_slot * slots.
processNotes.readinessProbeTrap: curl -s on /health EXITS 0 while the model is still loading (the body is a 503 JSON error). Poll the BODY for '"status":"ok"', or use curl -f. This session fell into it.
processNotes.sameFileAgentsRunSequentially: C-056: a clobbered fix does not fail the gate - it is simply absent, and the test that would have caught it is clobbered with it. Sequencing comes from the file touched, not from how small the change looks.
processNotes.agentStrayFileTrap: Run git status after ANY agent returns. A changed test count is the tell that a file arrived or vanished.
processNotes.mutationRevertTrap: A mutation harness that reverts with `git checkout <file>` DISCARDS UNCOMMITTED WORK. Snapshot with cp, restore from the snapshot, verify with cmp. The orchestrator did this to itself again at C-057 despite the note existing.
